svg.title: The same min-heap as a tree and as an array
svg.desc: h = [2, 5, 3, 9, 6, 4, 8]. Root 2 at index 0; 5 and 3 at indices 1 and 2; leaves 9, 6, 4, 8 at indices 3 to 6. Children of index 1 are indices 3 and 4 (values 9 and 6); the parent of index 5 is index 2 (value 3).
svg.text: min-heap h = [2, 5, 3, 9, 6, 4, 8], one structure, two views
